about.title: About
about.description: Akhi Furniture is a Dhaka workshop and showroom that designs and builds furniture for homes and offices, mostly made to order.
about.heroTitle: A Dhaka workshop that makes furniture for real rooms
story: Akhi Furniture began as a small workshop making beds and dining sets for families in Dhaka.

Today we design and build furniture for homes and offices, from a single bed to a full boardroom. Most of what we make is made to order: sized for the customer's room, in the wood and finish they choose.
We still work the way we started. Our own craftsmen cut, join, carve and finish every piece, and we show our real work, nothing else.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: How the Akhi Furniture website handles your privacy: no accounts, no stored forms, cookie-free analytics.

sections.text: This website does not have accounts, forms that store your details, or a shop. When you contact us, you do it in WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, by phone or by email, and those apps handle your messages under their own policies.

sections.title: What we measure
sections.text: We use cookie-free analytics to count page visits and clicks on our contact buttons. It does not identify you and does not follow you to other websites.

sections.title: The design brief
sections.text: The design brief on our Custom Furniture page runs only in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to us until you choose to send the message in WhatsApp.
